cards.arabic: ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

cards.headline: Als ’Imrans Frau sagte: „Mein Herr, ich gelobe Dir, was in meinem Mutterleib ist …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:35
source.excerpt: اذكر -أيها الرسول- ما كان من أمر مريم وأمها وابنها عيسى عليه السلام; لتردَّ بذلك على من ادعوا أُلوهية عيسى أو بنوَّته لله سبحانه، إذ قالت امرأة عمران حين حملت: يا ربِّ إني جعلت لك ما في بطني خالصا لك، لخدمة «بيت المقدس» ، فتقبَّل مني; إنك أنت وحدك السميع لدعائي، العليم بنيتي.

cards.arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
cards.translation: Als ’Imrans Frau sagte: „Mein Herr, ich gelobe Dir, was in meinem Mutterleib ist, für Deinen Dienst freigestellt. So nimm (es) von mir an! Du bist ja der Allhörende und Allwissende.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Story of Maryam's Birth: The wife of `Imran mentioned here is the mother of Maryam, and her name is Hannah bint Faqudh. Muhammad bin Ishaq mentioned that Hannah could not have children and that one day, she saw a bird feeding its chick.

Key barriers to clinical translation include insufficient distinction between prognostic and predictive markers, limited cross-trial validation, near-absent calibration reporting, and absent explainability.

cards.headline: Als sie sie dann zur Welt gebracht hatte, sagte sie: „Mein Herr …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:36
source.excerpt: فلما تمَّ حملها ووضعت مولودها قالت: ربِّ إني وضعتها أنثى لا تصلح للخدمة في «بيت المقدس» -والله أعلم بما وضَعَتْ، وسوف يجعل الله لها شأنًا- وقالت: وليس الذكر الذي أردت للخدمة كالأنثى في ذلك; لأن الذكر أقوى على الخدمة وأقْوَم بها، وإني سمَّيتها مريم، وإني حصَّنتها بك هي وذريَّتها من الشيطان المطرود من رحمتك.

cards.arabic: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَضَعْتُهَآ أُنثَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ ٱلذَّكَرُ كَٱلْأُنثَىٰ ۖ وَإِنِّى سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَإِنِّىٓ أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
cards.translation: Als sie sie dann zur Welt gebracht hatte, sagte sie: „Mein Herr, ich habe ein Mädchen zur Welt gebracht. Und Allah wußte sehr wohl, was sie zur Welt gebracht hatte, und der Knabe ist nicht wie das Mädchen. „Ich habe sie Maryam genannt, und ich stelle sie und ihre Nachkommenschaft unter Deinen Schutz vor dem gesteinigten Satan.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Story of Maryam's Birth: The wife of `Imran mentioned here is the mother of Maryam, and her name is Hannah bint Faqudh. Muhammad bin Ishaq mentioned that Hannah could not have children and that one day, she saw a bird feeding its chick.

cards.headline: Da nahm ihr Herr sie auf gütigste Art an und ließ sie auf schöne Weise heranwachsen und …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:37
source.excerpt: فاستجاب الله دعاءها وقبل منها نَذْرها أحسن قَبول، وتولَّى ابنتها مريم بالرعاية فأنبتها نباتًا حسنًا، ويسَّر الله لها زكريا عليه السلام كافلا فأسكنها في مكان عبادته، وكان كلَّما دخل عليها هذا المكان وجد عندها رزقًا هنيئًا معدّاً قال: يا مريم من أين لكِ هذا الرزق الطيب؟ قالت: هو رزق من عند الله. إن الله -بفضله- يرزق مَن يشاء مِن خلقه بغير حساب.

cards.arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
cards.translation: Da nahm ihr Herr sie auf gütigste Art an und ließ sie auf schöne Weise heranwachsen und gab sie Zakariyya zur Betreuung. Jedesmal, wenn Zakariyya zu ihr in die Zelle trat, fand er bei ihr Versorgung. Er sagte: „O Maryam, woher hast du das? Sie sagte: „Es kommt von Allah; Allah versorgt, wen Er will, ohne zu berechnen.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Da rief Zakariyya seinen Herrn an und sagte: „Mein Herr …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:38
source.excerpt: عندما رأى زكريا ما أكرم الله به مريم مِن رزقه وفضله توجه إلى ربه قائلا يا ربِّ أعطني من عندك ولدًا صالحًا مباركًا، إنك سميع الدعاء لمن دعاك.

cards.arabic: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
cards.translation: Da rief Zakariyya seinen Herrn an und sagte: „Mein Herr, schenke mir von Dir aus gute Nachkommenschaft! Du bist ja der Gebetserhörer.

cards.body: The Supplication of Zakariyya, and the Good News of Yahya's Birth: When Zakariyya saw that Allah provided sustenance for Maryam by giving her the fruits of winter in summer and the fruits of summer in winter, he was eager to have a child of his own.

cards.headline: Und da riefen ihm die Engel zu, während er betend in der Zelle stand: Allah verkündet …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:39
source.excerpt: فنادته الملائكة وهو واقف بين يدي الله في مكان صلاته يدعوه: أن الله يخبرك بخبر يسرُّك، وهو أنك سترزق بولد اسمه يحيى، يُصَدِّق بكلمة من الله -وهو عيسى بن مريم عليه السلام-، ويكون يحيى سيدًا في قومه، له المكانة والمنزلة العالية، وحصورًا لا يأتي الذنوب والشهوات الضارة، ويكون نبيّاً من الصالحين الذين بلغوا في الصَّلاح ذروته.

cards.arabic: فَنَادَتْهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٌ يُصَلِّى فِى ٱلْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۢا بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَحَصُورًا وَنَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
cards.translation: Und da riefen ihm die Engel zu, während er betend in der Zelle stand: Allah verkündet dir Yahya, ein Wort von Allah zu bestätigen, einen Herrn, einen Keuschen und Propheten von den Rechtschaffenen.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Supplication of Zakariyya, and the Good News of Yahya's Birth: When Zakariyya saw that Allah provided sustenance for Maryam by giving her the fruits of winter in summer and the fruits of summer in winter, he was eager to have a child of his own.

cards.headline: Mitigating hallucinations in healthcare AI

source.title: Mitigating hallucinations in healthcare AI: a systematic review of evidence-based strategies.
source.excerpt: Mitigating hallucinations in healthcare AI requires integrated approaches that combine technical and human-centered safeguards. We propose a typology of mitigation strategies, implementation considerations, and a replicable workflow to inform safer deployment in clinical settings.

cards.headline: Effects of exercise interventions on depressive symptoms in perimenopausal women in China

source.title: Effects of exercise interventions on depressive symptoms in perimenopausal women in China: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Exercise interventions may effectively alleviate depressive symptoms in Chinese perimenopausal women and represent a feasible non-pharmacological strategy for mental health management. However, given the substantial heterogeneity and potential publication bias among included studies, the findings should be interpreted cautiously.

cards.headline: Current and Future Applications of AI in EMS Training: A Scoping Review

source.title: Current and Future Applications of AI in EMS Training: A Scoping Review.
source.excerpt: Ethical and implementation challenges remain, but increased education and awareness can help ensure that AI is used to positively affect patient care.

cards.headline: Und er wird in der Wiege zu den Menschen sprechen und im Mannesalter und einer der …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:46
source.excerpt: ويكلم الناس وهو رضيع قبل أوان الكلام، ويدعوهم إلى الله وهو كبير قد اجتمعت قوته وكمل شبابه بما أوحاه الله إليه. وهذا تكليم النبوَّة والدعوة والإرشاد، وهو معدود من أهل الصلاح والفضل في قوله وعمله.

cards.arabic: وَيُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
cards.translation: Und er wird in der Wiege zu den Menschen sprechen und im Mannesalter und einer der Rechtschaffenen sein.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Delivering the Good News to Maryam of `Isa's Birth: This Ayah contains the glad tidings the angels brought to Maryam that she would give birth to a mighty son who will have a great future.

cards.headline: Sie sagte: „Mein Herr, wie sollte ich ein Kind haben …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:47
source.excerpt: قالت مريم متعجبة من هذا الأمر: أنَّى يكون لي ولد وأنا لست بذات زوج ولا بَغِيٍّ؟ قال لها المَلَك: هذا الذي يحدث لكِ ليس بمستبعد على الإله القادر، الذي يوجِد ما يشاء من العَدَم، فإذا أراد إيجاد شيء فإنما يقول له: «كُن» فيكون.

cards.arabic: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
cards.translation: Sie sagte: „Mein Herr, wie sollte ich ein Kind haben, wo mich (doch) kein menschliches Wesen berührt hat? Er (, der Engel,) sagte: „So (wird es sein); Allah erschafft, was Er will. Wenn Er eine Angelegenheit bestimmt, so sagt Er zu ihr nur: ,Sei!’ und so ist sie.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Delivering the Good News to Maryam of `Isa's Birth: This Ayah contains the glad tidings the angels brought to Maryam that she would give birth to a mighty son who will have a great future.

cards.headline: Machine Learning for Risk Stratification in Acute Pancreatitis

source.title: Machine Learning for Risk Stratification in Acute Pancreatitis: Current Evidence and Future Perspectives.
source.excerpt: Finally, we highlight future perspectives, including multimodal AI, prospective clinical validation and regulatory considerations that should facilitate the safe integration of AI-based decision-support tools into routine clinical practice.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in anaesthesiology

source.title: Artificial intelligence in anaesthesiology: why don't we have it in our hands after a decade of innovation? A systematic review and perspective.
source.excerpt: Machine learning represents a highly active and debated domain in anaesthesia, characterised by a substantial volume of published research. However, exceptionally few algorithmic models have successfully translated into practice-changing clinical tools.

cards.headline: Targeting the Undruggable: Deep Learning-Driven Design of Peptide Therapeutics in Cancer

source.title: Targeting the Undruggable: Deep Learning-Driven Design of Peptide Therapeutics in Cancer.
source.excerpt: We further explore how advances in artificial intelligence and computational modeling may reshape the rational design of next-generation peptide therapeutics and propose an integrated experimental-computational framework to facilitate the development of clinically actionable candidates.

cards.headline: Deep learning and machine learning in CT-based COPD diagnosis

source.title: Deep learning and machine learning in CT-based COPD diagnosis: Systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Both DL and ML models for diagnosing COPD using CT images exhibited high accuracy. There was no significant difference in diagnostic efficacy between the two types of AI models, and the addition of the MIL mechanism may enhance the performance of the DL model.

cards.headline: Vision-Based Artificial Intelligence Technologies for Epilepsy Monitoring

source.title: Vision-Based Artificial Intelligence Technologies for Epilepsy Monitoring: Scoping Review and Taxonomy Development Study.
source.excerpt: Vision-based AI technologies for epilepsy monitoring are still dominated by proof-of-concept and pilot evaluations, indicating a gap between technical feasibility and deployment-ready systems.

cards.headline: Early Detection of Keratoconus

source.title: Early Detection of Keratoconus: Diagnostic Advances and Their Impact on Visual Outcomes: A Systematic Review.
source.excerpt: Early keratoconus detection is crucial for preserving vision; and integrating multimodal, AI-supported diagnostics into routine care-especially for high-risk groups-enhances accuracy, improves outcomes, and reduces progression rates of disease.

cards.headline: Applications of artificial intelligence in cancer immunotherapy

source.title: Applications of artificial intelligence in cancer immunotherapy: a frontier review on enhancing treatment efficacy and safety.
source.excerpt: We also discuss future directions and challenges in applying AI to cancer immunotherapy, aiming to support further research and clinical translation.

cards.headline: Network biology to artificial intelligence

source.title: Network biology to artificial intelligence: building the next generation of predictive drug discovery.
source.excerpt: Ultimately, AI-driven systems biology approaches could contribute to the development of dynamic, patient-specific computational representations of biological systems, potentially accelerating precision medicine and transforming drug discovery from empirical experimentation toward predictive, mechanism-guided therapeutic design.

cards.headline: Biofilm-mediated antibiotic tolerance in bacterial pathogens

source.title: Biofilm-mediated antibiotic tolerance in bacterial pathogens: Integrated molecular networks and novel therapeutic avenues.
source.excerpt: In the past few years, the emergence of new anti-biofilm intervention approaches (matrix-degrading enzymes, phage therapy, nanomaterials, gene editing, etc.) revealed the possibility to break the limitations of conventional antibiotics by compromising structural integrity or interfering with signaling pathways, providing new ideas for drug-resistance infection control.

cards.headline: LDCT uptake and determinants of lung cancer screening in Asia

source.title: LDCT uptake and determinants of lung cancer screening in Asia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: LDCT uptake for lung cancer screening is lower in Asia than in academic programs, and it varies widely due to program design and population characteristics. Adopting smaller-scale screening designs and targeting key populations may help improve implementation efforts.

cards.headline: Promises and challenges of artificial intelligence in haematological diagnostics

source.title: Promises and challenges of artificial intelligence in haematological diagnostics.
source.excerpt: AI literacy is essential for haematologists to critically evaluate model outputs, effectively using them as decision support tools.

cards.headline: Generative AI in Radiotherapy Imaging

source.title: Generative AI in Radiotherapy Imaging: From Cross-Modality Synthesis to Foundation Model-Based Segmentation.
source.publisher: Journal of the Korean Society of Radiology
source.excerpt: Persistent challenges, including image hallucinations, algorithmic biases, and data privacy, must be addressed before these tools can be deployed safely.

cards.headline: A Systematic Literature Review of Precision Anesthesia Through Machine Learning

source.title: A Systematic Literature Review of Precision Anesthesia Through Machine Learning: Automated Drug Titration and Real-Time Physiologic Optimization.
source.excerpt: While ML-enabled precision anesthesia shows substantial promise for improving dosing accuracy, patient safety, and intraoperative efficiency, broad adoption will depend on rigorous clinical validation, clear regulatory pathways, and strong safety frameworks to ensure dependable performance in real-world settings.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Chest Computed Tomography Optimization

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Chest Computed Tomography Optimization: A Task-based Framework for Balancing Detectability and Radiation Dose.
source.excerpt: By integrating acquisition, reconstruction, and continuous feedback mechanisms, AI has the potential to support consistent, patient-specific optimization while maintaining diagnostic efficacy when appropriately validated.

cards.translation: Und Er wird ihn die Schrift, die Weisheit, die Tora und das Evangelium lehren.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Description of `Isa and the Miracles He Performed: Allah states that the good news brought to Maryam about `Isa was even better because Allah would teach him, الْكِتَـبَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ (the Book and Al-Hikmah).

cards.headline: Und (Er wird ihn schicken) als einen Gesandten zu den Kindern Isra’ils ( …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:49
source.excerpt: ويجعله رسولا إلى بني إسرائيل، ويقول لهم: إني قد جئتكم بعلامة من ربكم تدلُّ على أني مرسل من الله، وهي أني أصنع لكم من الطين مثل شكل الطير، فأنفخ فيه فيكون طيرًا حقيقيا بإذن الله، وأَشفي مَن وُلِد أعمى، ومَن به برص، وأُحيي من كان ميتًا بإذن الله، وأخبركم بما تأكلون وتدَّخرون في بيوتكم من طعامكم.

cards.arabic: وَرَسُولًا إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنِّى قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ أَنِّىٓ أَخْلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَأَنفُخُ فِيهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيْرًۢا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ وَأُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا تَأْكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِى بُيُوتِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
cards.translation: Und (Er wird ihn schicken) als einen Gesandten zu den Kindern Isra’ils (, zu denen er sagen wird): ,Gewiß, ich bin ja mit einem Zeichen von eurem Herrn zu euch gekommen: daß ich euch aus Lehm (etwas) schaffe, (was so aussieht) wie die Gestalt eines Vogels, und dann werde ich ihm einhauchen, und da wird es ein (wirklicher) Vogel sein. Und ich werde mit Allahs Erlaubnis den Blindgeborenen und den Weißgefleckten heilen und werde Tote mit Allahs Erlaubnis wieder lebendig machen. Und ich werde euch kundtun, was ihr eßt und was ihr in euren Häusern aufspeichert. Darin ist wahrlich ein Zeichen für euch, wenn ihr gläubig seid.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Description of `Isa and the Miracles He Performed: Allah states that the good news brought to Maryam about `Isa was even better because Allah would teach him, الْكِتَـبَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ (the Book and Al-Hikmah).
